verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an API-first inference cloud. It is driven programmatically through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with token auth set via base_url and api_key, so it runs headlessly in scripts or CI without any UI. Automation-friendly controls include fail_fast for an immediate 429 instead of waiting, and a flex service tier aimed at asynchronous workloads. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation or examples, a first-party CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
